checks.name: survivor-idle-ignores-outbox

replace.from: pending == Set() and not(batch) and outbox == [] and owing == Set())
replace.to: pending == Set() and not(batch) and owing == Set())

checks.why: Every item in the outbox is also pending (deliver.ts:165, :194 remember before post), so pending == {} already implies an empty outbox, except for the hidden reminder, which idleMeansLanded leaves out. Without the outbox check, a held reminder would let the host go quiet, and the renew swap would dispose it; the model does not model renew, so no property sees that.
